senses.sense_definition: To stop something from happening or to keep someone from doing something.

examples.text: I brush my teeth regularly to <w>prevent</w> tooth decay.

senses.sense_definition: To take proactive measures or act in a way that stops a problem before it starts.

examples.text: It is always better to <w>prevent</w> than to cure a disease.

target_lang_translations.tr: Bir hastalığı <w>önlemek</w>, onu tedavi etmekten her zaman daha iyidir.

target_lang_translations.pl: Zawsze lepiej jest <w>zapobiegać</w>, niż leczyć chorobę.
target_lang_translations.de: Es ist immer besser, einer Krankheit <w>vorzubeugen</w>, als sie zu heilen.
target_lang_translations.fr: Il vaut toujours mieux <w>prévenir</w> une maladie que la guérir.

target_lang_definitions.ru: Принимать упреждающие меры, чтобы остановить проблему до ее возникновения.

senses.sense_definition: To be beforehand with or to <w>anticipate</w> someone's actions or needs.
